title: CertPassly question format v2
description: Author and import document for one question. schema_version is a const. question_key plus integer version identify a record so a re-import updates and never duplicates. The learner block must never contain answers. The type enum is exactly the 30 keys parsed from question_types.php. answer_key_status is owner_key, researched_official, researched_unverified, or answer_not_found. The v1 spelling as_in_source_file is not valid in this schema; scripts/migrate_v1_to_v2.py maps it to owner_key. Free-trial caps belong in site entitlements. This schema has no trial fields.

version.description: Integer revision of this question_key. A re-import with the same key and a higher version updates the record. It must not create a duplicate key.

answer_key_status.description: Canonical v2 status. as_in_source_file is not valid here; a one-time migration script maps that v1 spelling to owner_key.

legacy_answer_key_status.description: Optional audit field. After a v1-to-v2 migration this may record the original v1 status spelling (for example as_in_source_file or flagged_for_owner). The stored answer_key_status must still be a canonical v2 value.

conversion_exact.description: True when a v1-to-v2 migration confirmed the HTML or SVG transcription with a deterministic check. False when the item is listed in the cannot-convert report.

conversion_notes.description: Optional notes from scripts/migrate_v1_to_v2.py, for example a type remap from image_based_choice to single_choice.

reference_media.description: Reviewer-only original images (answer-area or marked-key shots) kept as reference assets. Never used as the learner question and never placed in the learner payload.

max_choices.description: Must be authored. Never derive this from the number of correct options.
